TRAVEL RETAIL INSIDER | Sep 12 2026

HAINAN OFFSHORE DUTY-FREE SALES FALL 11% IN AUGUST

By TRI desk

Offshore duty-free sales in Hainan fell 11 percent year on year in August to about 2.6 billion yuan, according to customs data, the 20th consecutive monthly decline. Shopper numbers dropped 7 percent while average spend per shopper slipped to around 6,100 yuan.

Operators blamed weak consumer confidence and the shift of affluent Chinese travellers back to overseas destinations such as Japan, South Korea and Europe. Beauty remains the largest category, while watches and jewellery have been hit hardest.

Hainan's island-wide customs regime, introduced in late 2025, has not yet reversed the trend.
